rule:
(fixed in the order file before any picker runs on FRESH):
    target = total flat queries wanted. 'take_all' groups enter whole. The rest R = target - their flat count is split over
    the 'fill' groups by weight (ceil(R * w / sum w) each); each fill group takes flights in its listed order until it
    reaches its share. Flat = plane_frac >= 0.85 from results/labels (the normal kpbench label pipeline).
reason: FRESH = new non-HELD_OUT TartanAir trajectories for near-miss retests. target = 2 x the 936 DEV flat queries. Environments as in DEV (oldtown, hospital, factory): oldtown has DEV's largest flat share but the pool holds only its 6 Easy trajectories, so all 6 enter; the rest is split hospital : factory = 2 : 1 (DEV flat ratio 183 : 92). Factory takes its Hard trajectories first (Hard preferred), then Easy. Within a group the order is the depth-only flat-density estimate (share of grid plane_frac >= 0.85 on every 30th frame, no detector, no picker), densest first, so the flat target is met with fewer queries (gate cost scales with all queries). Stop when a group reaches its share by the real label (SuperPoint top-300 plane_frac >= 0.85).
